menus.reason_name_invalid: The menu name is not valid — use 1 to 120 characters, for example "Footer menu".
menus.reason_locale_invalid: This language is not turned on for the website — turn it on in Settings › Website languages and try again.
menus.reason_item_invalid: This item is no longer in the menu (it may have just been removed in another tab) — reload the page to see the latest version.
menus.reason_target_invalid: The page, category or product you picked no longer exists — choose another source for this item.
menus.reason_url_invalid: The address is not right — use a path starting with /, #, https://, a phone number or an email.
menus.reason_label_invalid: The item's label is not valid — type the words visitors will see, for example "Contact".
menus.reason_parent_invalid: The item can't go here (the parent item is gone or sits inside it) — drag it to another item.
menus.reason_depth_exceeded: This menu can only go :depth levels deep where it is shown — move the item up a level.
menus.reason_region_invalid: The current theme has no such area — choose another one in "Where it shows on the website".
menus.reason_menu_in_use: The menu is shown somewhere on the website — choose another menu for that place before deleting it.
menus.reason_same_invalid: This area can't share another area's menu — choose a menu of its own.
menus.reason_same_chain: The area it would follow already follows another one (or is followed itself) — give one of them a menu of its own first.
menus.reason_draft_stale: Someone changed this menu after you opened it (in another tab or by another person) — reload the page, then make your changes again.
menus.reason_menu_full: This menu already has 2,000 items, the most it can hold — remove items you no longer use, then try again.
menus.reason_option_invalid: One of the item's display options is not valid (icon, description, badge, large panel or device) — check them and try again.
menus.reason_input_invalid: The request was not complete — reload the page and try again.

entries.btn_anchor_none_title: No part of this page has a link anchor yet.
entries.btn_anchor_none_how: How: in the part to scroll to, open “Look” → “Advanced” → “Link anchor” and type a short name such as quote. That part then shows here to choose.
entries.btn_zalo_label: Zalo number, or a zalo.me link
entries.btn_tel_hint: On a phone, a tap calls at once. On a computer, visitors see the number to call.
entries.btn_zalo_hint: A tap opens Zalo to message this number. The number must be registered on Zalo.
entries.btn_mail_label: Email address that receives the mail
entries.btn_mail_subject_ph: For example: Asking for a quote
entries.btn_mail_hint: A tap opens the mail app with this address and subject filled in.
entries.btn_file_gone_name: The file is no longer in the library
entries.btn_file_none: No file chosen yet. Visitors who press the button download this file.
entries.btn_file_pick: Choose a file from the library
entries.btn_file_dialog_title: Choose a file for visitors to download
entries.btn_file_dialog_sub: Documents in the website’s Media library (PDF, Word, Excel). Visitors who press the button download the file.
entries.btn_file_dialog_empty_title: The library has no documents yet.
entries.btn_file_dialog_empty_how: Upload a PDF, Word or Excel file to the Media library, then come back here to choose it.
entries.btn_err_page_none: Choose a page or post for this button.
entries.btn_err_page_gone: The page “:page” is no longer on the website (it may have been deleted or moved). Choose another page.
entries.btn_err_url_none: Paste the link address, such as https://facebook.com/yourcompany.
entries.btn_err_url_unsafe: A link that starts with javascript: or data: is not safe and is blocked. Paste a link that starts with https://.
entries.btn_err_url_internal: This is a page of your own website. Choose “Open a page of this website” so the button does not break when the page moves.
entries.btn_err_url_invalid: The link is not right: it must start with https://, such as https://facebook.com/yourcompany.
entries.btn_err_anchor_none: Choose the part the button scrolls to.
entries.btn_err_anchor_gone: No part of this page has the link anchor “:anchor” any more (the anchor changed or the part was removed). Choose another part.
entries.btn_err_tel_none: Type the phone number, such as 0915 668 383.
entries.btn_err_tel_invalid: The phone number is not right: it needs 10 digits starting with 0, such as 0915 668 383.
entries.btn_err_zalo_none: Type the phone number registered on Zalo, or paste a zalo.me link.
entries.btn_err_zalo_link: The Zalo link is not right: it must look like https://zalo.me/0915668383.
entries.btn_err_zalo_invalid: The Zalo number is not right: it needs 10 digits starting with 0, such as 0915 668 383. Or paste your zalo.me link.
entries.btn_err_mail_none: Type the email address that receives the mail, such as contact@yourcompany.com.
entries.btn_err_mail_invalid: The email is not right: it must look like name@yourcompany.com.
entries.btn_err_file_none: Choose a file from the library for visitors to download.
entries.btn_err_file_gone: The chosen file is no longer in the library. Choose another file.
entries.err_block_button_page_missing: A button points to a page that is not on this website. Choose the button’s page again.
entries.err_block_button_file_missing: A button points to a file that is not in this website’s library. Choose the button’s file again.
layout_slots.err_slot_invalid: This place for blocks does not exist. Reload the page and try again.
layout_slots.err_locale_invalid: This language is not turned on for the website. Turn the language on first, or remove its content.
layout_slots.err_too_many: This place holds at most :max blocks. Remove some blocks.
layout_slots.err_type_slot: The “:block” block can only go in a post’s side column or at the end of a post. Move it there or remove it.
catalog.chip_sort_aria: Remove the sort “:name”, back to the default “:default”
catalog.lc_why_default_only: Only the source version can be edited for now
catalog.price_ask_tip: No price entered — the website shows the “Request a quote” button
catalog.sku_title: SKU — your own product code for looking things up, for example MT-850
catalog.thumb_n: :n images — the first one is the cover image
catalog.trash_days_left: :n days left before it is deleted for good
catalog.trash_auto_note: Items in the Trash are deleted for good after :days days. Restore puts a product back as a draft — its SKU and address stay as they were.
catalog.move_published_hint: Visitors see it on the website at once
catalog.move_archived_hint: Visitors no longer see it; the content is kept
catalog.move_draft_hint: Hidden from the website so you can keep editing
catalog.toast_status_archived: Took “:name” off the website. Its content is kept.
catalog.toast_status_draft: Moved “:name” to draft — visitors no longer see it.
catalog.status_route_conflict: Could not publish: the product's address is already used by another page or category. Change the address and publish again.
catalog.ed.toast_offline: Not saved because the connection was lost. What you typed is still here — press Try again.
catalog.ed.summary_ph: 4-flute AlTiN-coated end mill, cuts steel up to 45 HRC, lasts twice as long as an ordinary cutter.
catalog.ed.sv_dirty_draft: :n unsaved changes — saves automatically in 3 seconds
catalog.ed.sv_dirty_live: :n unsaved changes — press Update so visitors see them
catalog.ed.sv_error: Not saved — some fields need fixing
catalog.ed.toast_published: Published — visitors can see it now at :url.
catalog.ed.toast_updated: Updated — visitors see the changes now.
catalog.ed.toast_status_elsewhere: The product's status was just changed elsewhere (now: :status). The content is saved; the status was not changed.
catalog.ed.leave_new: This product has not been saved. If you leave this page now, what you wrote will be lost.
catalog.ed.leave_draft: Your latest changes have not been saved automatically yet. If you leave the page now, they will be lost.
catalog.ed.leave_other: If you leave this page now, your edits will be lost.
catalog.ed.less_sub: The editor will remember this choice next time
catalog.ed.summary_hint: Shown under the product name on list pages and when shared.
catalog.ed.summary_old_long: The old summary is :n characters long, over this field's :max. Save without editing this field and the old summary is kept as it is; if you edit it, shorten it to :max characters.
catalog.ed.summary_old_html: The old summary has formatting (bold, paragraphs…). This field shows only its text. Save without editing this field and the old summary is kept as it is; if you edit it, the new summary will be plain text.
catalog.ed.summary_too_long: The summary can be at most :max characters — please shorten it.
catalog.ed.slug_moves: This product is published. When you save, the old address :old forwards to the new one — visitors and Google will not get lost.
catalog.ed.pub_never: Never published — set when you first press Publish
catalog.ed.seen_ask: Yes — without a price, with a “Request a quote” button
catalog.ed.seen_no: No — the product is not on the website
catalog.ed.sku_hint: Your own item code for look-ups, for example MT-850. Optional. Each code belongs to one product only, including products in the Trash.
catalog.trash_note: This product is in the Trash — press Restore to keep editing it.
catalog.row_gone: This product is no longer in the list — it may have been deleted or just changed by someone else. Reload the list.
catalog.undo_gone: Could not undo: the product was deleted or is no longer there.
catalog.undo_conflict: Could not undo: the product's address is now used by another page or category.
catalog.status_unchanged: “:name” is already in this status, so nothing was changed.
catalog.name_required: The name cannot be empty — the old name is kept.
catalog.name_too_long: The name can be at most :max characters — please shorten it.
catalog.slug_invalid: The address needs at least one letter or digit, for example “end-mill-d10”.
catalog.slug_owner_product: The address “:slug” is already used by the product “:name”. Add a few words to make it different.
catalog.slug_owner_product_trash: The address “:slug” is already used by the product “:name” in the Trash. Add a few words to make it different.
catalog.slug_owner_category: The address “:slug” belongs to the category “:name”. Add a few words to make it different, for example “:slug-cnc”.
catalog.slug_owner_page: The address “:slug” matches a page that already exists on the website. Add a few words to make it different, for example “:slug-cnc”.
catalog.toast_slug_redirect: The old address now redirects to the new one.
catalog.undo_slug_taken: Could not undo: the old address is now used by another product or page.
catalog.bulk_title_none: No selected product can do this: :why
catalog.bulk_title_purge: Cannot be undone — you will be asked again
catalog.bulk_none_can: No selected product can be done for “:label”: :why.
catalog.bulk_status_published: Published :count products — visitors see them now.
catalog.bulk_status_archived: Took :count products off the website. Their content is kept.
catalog.bulk_failed_route: :count products were not published: their address belongs to another page or category.
catalog.bulk_conflict: Someone else changed these products at the same moment. Nothing was changed — press the button again.
catalog.bulk_cat_gone: This category is no longer there. Pick another one.
catalog.bulk_cat_same: The selected products are already in “:category” — nothing changed.
catalog.bulk_cat_done: Changed the main category of :count products to “:category”.
catalog.bulk_cat_redirect: :count published products now send visitors from the old address to the new one.
catalog.bulk_cat_failed: :count products were not moved: the new address belongs to a page or another category.
catalog.undo_partial: Undone for :count products; :left products are gone or were changed, so they stay as they are.
catalog.bulk_sel_header: Select all :n products on this page
catalog.cat_title_many: Change the main category of :count products
catalog.cat_for_many: All the selected products move to the same main category.
catalog.cat_empty: This website has no product categories yet.
catalog.cat_note: The main category decides which group page the product appears on in the website.
catalog.cat_note_pub: :count products are published: the old address redirects to the new one.
catalog.purge_text_one: This cannot be undone. The pictures, price and every language version of this product are deleted. The SKU and address become free for other products.
catalog.purge_text_many: This cannot be undone. The pictures, price and every language version of these :count products are deleted. The SKUs and addresses become free for other products.
